summary: PRE-LAUNCH EXECUTIVE SYSTEM AUDIT COMPLETE - All 10 core user flows tested for production readiness. CapyMatch Volleyball Recruiting CRM is functioning well across all critical paths.

NEW_USER_FLOW.details: Register → login → onboarding questionnaire works. Quiz intro shows 'Let's Build Your Volleyball Journey' with benefits cards. 6-question quiz progresses correctly with Back/Continue navigation and form validation.

RETURNING_USER_LOGIN.details: Login as demo@capymatch.com/demo2026 → redirects to /board Dashboard with personalized greeting 'Good evening, Emma'

DASHBOARD_STATS.details: All stat cards show real data: 10 schools tracked, 63% response rate, 2 replies this week, 3 awaiting reply. Follow-ups Due shows overdue items (University of Florida 3 days, Penn State 1 day). School Spotlight shows 6 active schools with status badges and next steps.

PIPELINE_BOARD.details: My Schools → shows all 10 demo schools grouped by status: Overdue (2), Outreach (2), Waiting (2), In Convo (4). Filter chips work. Progress ring shows 10 schools.

JOURNEY_PAGE.details: Penn State journey shows: risk badges (Roster Tight, Timeline Awareness), stage progress bar (Added→Outreach→Talking→Visit→Offer→Committed), School Intelligence link button visible, Follow-up Due alert visible, conversation timeline with coach messages LEFT and user messages RIGHT.

SCHOOL_DETAIL_PAGE.details: School Intelligence on Journey → /school/psu.edu loads. School info visible (Penn State, D1, Big Ten, 40% Match). Intelligence cards section shows: RECRUITING TIMELINE (Unknown), ROSTER OUTLOOK (Unknown), Commitment Stability, Why This School / Why Not with AI-generated strengths and factors.

FIND_SCHOOLS.details: Find Schools → 48 school cards visible. Search works (Ohio filter returns 5 schools). Division badges (D1, D2, D3) visible. Top Match banner shows Alabama State 40% match. Details button on cards works.

EMPTY_STATES.details: No blank screens found. All pages have proper content, guidance text, or empty state handling.

COMMITTED_SCHOOL.details: Stanford on pipeline → shows Committed Hero celebration card with capybara mascot and message 'The hard work paid off. Congratulations! This is a moment to celebrate with your family.' School Intelligence link visible below celebration card.

DARK_MODE.details: Theme toggle button (data-testid='theme-toggle-btn') works. Background changes from rgb(245,245,247) light to rgb(15,18,25) dark. Toggle back works correctly. Dark mode renders all elements properly.
